fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Advanced non-small cell lung cancer, pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, gastric cancer (including gastroesophageal junction carcinoma), or esophageal cancer.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: The trial enrolls multiple solid tumor types including advanced NSCLC without an explicit numbered stage list.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText:
Must have received at least 1 prior approved systemic therapy:
* Part 1: progression or relapse following standard treatments and have no other appropriate standard of care option.
* Part 2: maximum of 2 prior lines of systemic therapy in the advanced setting.
